about.title: Speed & Agility Coach
about.bio: I specialize in the athletic qualities that change games — first-step explosion, change of direction, linear speed, and reactive agility. My athletes don't just get faster, they move with purpose and confidence in every sport situation.

hero.headline: Faster First Step. Sharper Cuts. Bigger Plays.
hero.subline: Speed and agility training — linear speed development, change of direction, and reactive movement for multi-sport athletes.

packages.title: Speed Development
packages.description: 6-week linear speed block — sprint mechanics, acceleration, top-end speed, and deceleration. 3 sessions per week with weekly assessment.

packages.title: Agility & Change of Direction
packages.description: 6-week COD program — lateral movement, cutting mechanics, reactive drills, and position-specific pattern work. Perfect for skill position athletes.

packages.title: Multi-Sport Athlete Program
packages.description: 12-week combined speed and agility program for athletes who want both — linear speed and change of direction developed in parallel with sport-specific application.

testimonials.quote: My son dropped his 40 time from a 4.9 to a 4.65 in 8 weeks. The mechanics work was something we'd never seen from any other coach.
testimonials.name: Anthony J.

testimonials.quote: My change of direction on the soccer field is completely different now. I'm getting away from defenders I used to have no chance against.
testimonials.name: Sofia R.

success_stories.name: Jaylen W.
success_stories.story: Jaylen had natural speed but poor mechanics that were costing him time and making him predictable. We rebuilt his start mechanics and lateral cut patterns over one summer.
success_stories.result: 40 Time 4.58 · Team Leading Rusher · D2 Offer

faq.question: What sports do you train athletes from?
faq.answer: All sports where speed and agility matter — football, soccer, basketball, lacrosse, baseball, track, and more. Programs are sport-specific.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: Athletes from 9 years old through high school and adult level. Youth sessions focus on movement literacy; older athletes focus on speed and power.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a local turf facility or track. Exact location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How do I know which package to choose?
faq.answer: Start with the free session — I'll assess your movement and recommend the program that aligns with your sport and season calendar.

faq.question: Do you do group sessions?
faq.answer: Yes — small group sessions (3–5 athletes) are available for teams or position groups. Contact me for pricing.
